children: Romania's consumer price inflation (ROCPI=ECI) fell to 6.17% on the year in August from 8.16% the previous month, below expectations, data from the National Statistics Board showed on Friday.
The median forecast of a Reuters poll of analysts put Romanian inflation at 6.30% year-on-year, above the central bank's 1.5%-3.5% target.
Data showed prices rose 0.22% on the month in August, with food prices down 0.71%, non-food prices up 0.61% and services up 0.71%.
